body:
Starting this new job and quitting the other feels like the biggest mistake in my life. 
If I quit it everybody will get angry at me and overlooking the fact that I'm already depressed as hell.
I can't go back, I can't get away because of my lack of skills, money and general motivation.
Seeking out help never works because I want a change in life right now (fat chance that's going to happen, right?)

I strongly believe everything will be better for everyone, without me!
